newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian scientist kills himself over wage delays.
newsitem.headline: Russian scientist kills himself over wage delays.

text.p: A Russian geophyicist committed suicide after not being paid for more than six months, Itar-Tass reported on Friday.
The scientist, Viktor Staroseltsev of the Nalchik Mountain Geophysics Institute in southern Russia, left a note explaining he was unable to support his family and saw no end to his troubles.

Since the fall of the Soviet Union, many once well-financed scientific institutes have found it difficult to pay their bills. Some scientists have packed away their test tubes to work as guards or taxi drivers to make ends meet.
In October, a leading nuclear physicist in the Ural Mountain region shot himself, also because of financial troubles at his institute.
